reason: ^RDP container fixtures? unavailable: (no container runtime available|the docker daemon runs windows containers)
why: the xrdp suite (test_rdp.py) needs the rdp-server Linux container (xrdp + the FreeRDP NLA shadow). The hosted macOS runners ship no container runtime; on Windows the daemon runs only Windows containers or never comes up (#4842). Since #5175 builds the sidecar there, these 13 skips moved here from the baseline (where they counted as 'RDP sidecar not built'); the sidecar itself is graded on every OS by test_rdp_sidecar.py. The cap fails the lane when one more RDP suite skips for this reason.
